verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All three memberships and all three exponent formulas are present with the same rationals: the wave residual class is `UniformVelocity … (1/2+σ)` over the nonzero harmonics of `residualBlock` (B = 1/2+σ, cf. `waveExponent`), the two tangential mean residuals are in `MeanClass (1+σ)` and the three defects in `UnweightedClass (1+σ)` (C* = 1+σ, cf. `meanExponent`), and σ_j = 1/5 + j/10 is `sigma_formula`, instantiated at stage j by `state_runInvariant`. Two routine rewritings. (i) The paper's W/M/S are the weighted classes `WaveClass` (weight √ζ·P), `MeanClass` (weight ζ) and `UnweightedClass` (weight 1); the defect class is stated on `G.slowStrip` rather than `G.strip`, which is the right carrier since the three defects are functions of the slow variables only. (ii) The invariant's `mean` field bounds the *good* mean residual `meanGoodResidual = meanResidual − meanExcluded`, not the paper's exact E_θ, E_z; the exact residuals carry the same M_{1+σ} bound by `raw_mean_bounds`, whose proof is a few lines from the all-power flat axis alias (`axisFlat`) and the vanishing gaussian angular mean (`gaussianMean`).
